resolution: Fixed the fly-through regression the ceiling head-bonk (aee4d158a) introduced: jumping while climbing a staircase toward a landing dropped the player through the steps and pinned them under the floor. Cause: the bonk seated the head at the overhead underside via py = ceiling - player_height, but a landing floor at the TOP of a stair has its underside above your head while you climb, so ceiling - height computes below the stair surface and the clamp yanked the feet underground. Fix (framework/game/physics.zig): bound the downward clamp by the ground support — py = min(py, max(ceiling - player_height, support)) where support = max(groundAt, heightfieldFloorAt) under the feet. Real headroom (jump into a roof from open ground) still seats the head at the ceiling; no headroom means you're climbing ONTO the slab, so the feet stay on the support and the normal step-up mounts you (slope-walkable already skips the side-push). Upward velocity still zeroed. Added test 'head bonk: a low floor above the ground never drops the feet through it'. no-V8 loader builds clean; game-physics 41/42 (the one red, hollow-ramp-slab, predates this work). SHA f11187303. Needs Compile + relaunch (loader Zig change).
